verdict.rationale: The evidence documents a native REST API at /api/v1/*, OpenAI-like and Anthropic-compatible endpoints, and the `lms` CLI, but no item mentions an official SDK or client library for any language. A REST API is a building block a developer could wrap, not an official SDK, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
